item.title: Cenote Xulo
item.description:
About

From https://issuu.com

Xulo is one of four cenotes of the Caterpillar Cave System and was discovered about seven years ago. The system is considered small by Mexican standards, although as many as 13,500 meters of its passages have been explored and surveyed so far.

The magic really begins after a few steps down when kneeling in the shallow, pristine water surrounded by pure white stalactites. After going head down, a short way, you enter the first clear, large and delicate room, full of speleothems. It resembles the interior of a cathedral. Continuing, you reach the second section, where the sulphur has left layers of yellow and black marks on the cave formations. Submerged roots have invaded the gas pocket that leads to the first minor restriction. The reward awaits you on the other side, where you will find a gigantic room haunted by what could be named after Giacometti’s sculpture “Walking Men”.

Sistema Dos Ojos is not only one of the world’s largest underwater cave complexes, it also boast one of the largest and most beautiful cavern dives. Dos Ojos, which means “Two Eyes” in Spanish, is located just south of the X’el Ha ecopark. As you drive the bumpy dirt road back from the entrance, bear in mind that the original explorers of this system had to make this trip on foot, with their equipment hung on the back of burros.

Portions of the following information were taken from the cenotesoftherivieramaya.com Cenote Location - Go exactly three kilometers south of Puerto Aventuras on Highway 307 or 13.0 kilometers north of the Akumal C.D. entrance. Take dirt road going west up over hill past the power lines 1 kilometer. Sign in at gate through local dive/snorkel businesses. Drive one kilometer to parking area…OR..enter Sistema PonDeRosa at the Kantun Chi road entrance 300 Meters north of PonDeRosa road entrance. Follow it back to property office, pay dive site fee. Enter at Cenote Kantun Chi , Cenote Zacil, Uchil Ha or Sask Leem Ha. You can enter Sistema PonDeRosa at Cenote Azul or Cenote Cristalino. You can enter Sistema PonDeRosa at Cenote Chickin Ha Accessibility - EASY, Wide cement steps and platform leading from parking area down to the water. Well maintained foot paths around the cenote and surrounding property. Public toilets available Cave Description - Both freshwater and saltwater zones with halocline beginning at 33 feet (10 meters). Vivid displays of fresh water drainage. Saltwater areas are typical examples of erosion while fresh water areas show calcium carbonate formations Best Dives - The River Run Circuit, Upstream to Cenote Chickin Ha, To The Chapel Room, To Cenote Azul
